mapper.select: select * from student_schedule_analysis_record where user_id = #{userId} and is_delete = 0 order by update_time desc, id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into student_schedule_analysis_record ( user_id, source_file_name, source_file_url, extracted_json, matched_json, insights_json, semester_label, status, is_delete ) values ( #{userId}, #{sourceFileName}, #{sourceFileUrl}, #{extractedJson}, #{matchedJson}, #{insightsJson}, #{semesterLabel}, #{status}, 0 )
mapper.update: update student_schedule_analysis_record set source_file_name = #{sourceFileName}, source_file_url = #{sourceFileUrl}, extracted_json = #{extractedJson}, matched_json = #{matchedJson}, insights_json = #{insightsJson}, semester_label = #{semesterLabel}, status = #{status}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
